details:
Concept

ASTRA VAULT is designed as a digital archive that preserves the history and legacy of important space exploration missions. Many historic spacecraft and missions have completed their journeys, but their achievements, discoveries, and scientific contributions remain valuable. Our concept is to bring this information together in one interactive platform.

The website showcases three missions: Apollo 11, the Opportunity Rover, and Voyager 1. Through mission archives, images, timelines, and interactive search features, ASTRA VAULT makes space exploration history easier to explore and understand.

Our vision is to connect the achievements of past space missions with the curiosity of future explorers.Tool Used: ChatGPT
